title: Svenska verb — clusters, forms and phrase pairs

tenseOrder.note: Standard Swedish 'verbets tema' — the principal parts, always cited in this order. The imperative is not a principal part; it is the bare stem and is derivable, so it is listed last as a derived form. Wiktionary's headword line shows present, preterite, supine, imperative — the same sequence with the infinitive implied (it is the lemma) and the imperative appended.
tenseOrder.supineNote: Within the vowel changers the supine vowel is only ever u, or a return to the vowel of the infinitive. supineMove records which: 'u' or 'home'.
